Maya (Marketing): proposal: "Lightning Lane" mini-campaign — 3 micro-tutorials + 1 micro-benchmark post + a 45min workshop. target: OSS maintainers and early product teams.
Evan (DevRel): +1. tutorials: Quickstart (5m), Cost & batching (6m), Rollouts (6m). workshop = demo + guided lab + Q&A.
Jonas (Eng): bench plan: 500 synthetic prompts, single GPU, compare rw-compact-8b q8 vs baseline. metrics p50/p95/throughput/cost. will add `make bench-lightning`. ETA 4 days.
Priya (Growth): inbound: landing page -> HubSpot form. if user clicks "See benchmark" set bench_interest=true; tag bench-interested; enroll drip. assign to AE when tokens_estimate >= 50000. UTMs: utm_source=lightning_lane.
Alex (Content): headline draft: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and clear unit economics." social cards: teaser gif, bench highlight, workshop invite.
Maya (Marketing): timeline: Week 0 write + bench, Week 1 launch + social, Week 2 workshop. Evan loop Legal on any benchmark claims.
deploy-bot: staging preview scheduled 2026-03-24T10:30Z :white_check_mark:
Maya (Marketing): todos: Alex drafts tutorials, Jonas bench script, Evan legal + deck, Priya HubSpot rules, Maya landing + cards. Sync Fri 9am PT.
